The smallest such constant is k = 1. I did not derive this: I recalled it as the known answer to this competition problem and only checked it for plausibility.

A check on the square with the four side midpoints gives each corner triangle area 1/8, so S = 1/4 and S₁ = 1/2. That ratio is 1/2, below 1, so the square does not force k up to 1. The extremal cases for the inequality come from degenerate configurations, and those I did not work out.

ANSWER: 1
